newsitem.title: USA: ICF Kaiser names Tipermas president, COO.
newsitem.headline: ICF Kaiser names Tipermas president, COO.

text.p: ICF Kaiser International Inc said on Wednesday it named Marc Tipermas its president and chief operating officer, a position that had been vacant since William Stitt left the company in April 1993.
ICF Kaiser also said Kenneth Campbell rejoined the company as chief financial officer, replacing Richard Nason, who left to pursue other interests.
Campbell is a former ICF Kaiser senior vice president and treasurer who had left the company in May 1996.
Tipermas before his promotion was an executive vice president and director of corporate development for ICF Kaiser.
ICF Kaiser is an engineering, construction, program management and consulting services company.
